answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 2624 Country: India Title: I am a commerce graduate. ihave worked in hospital for 3 years due to some family problems, therefore ihave sound knowledge of application of primary medicine of allopathic including many antibiotics. Unfortunately i haven't any certificate by recognised institutes. My Question is that one can run allopathic dispensary like me without any certificate of any institutes recognised under the rule of Govt. of India , where it is prohibited in India. Is it allowable in the view of Islam? Question: I am a commerce graduate. ihave worked in hospital for 3 years due to some family problems, therefore ihave sound knowledge of application of primary medicine of allopathic including many antibiotics. Unfortunately i haven't any certificate by recognised institutes. My Question is that one can run allopathic dispensary like me without any certificate of any institutes recognised under the rule of Govt. of India , where it is prohibited in India. Is it allowable in the view of Islam? Answer ID: 2624 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 14/14=J) One who learnt medical knowledge and practiced it with any expert and the trainer relied upon him and gave him certificate of the same, then according to Shariah he has right to adopt the profession. Since, you do not meet the above-mentioned conditions therefore you are not allowed to adopt the medical profession. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
